title: Sous-Chef for a Day and Nastya's Kidnapping

scenes.title: Lyova's Sudden Vacation
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov scolds Max over a soup before discovering that sous-chef Lyova is leaving on vacation using a request form the Chef signed while drunk.

scenes.title: Max Becomes Sous-Chef and Nastya Disappears
scenes.summary: To spite his stubborn veterans, Chef Barinov appoints Max as acting sous-chef on the spot, while Nastya's worried parents call Kostya looking for their missing daughter.

scenes.title: Inspecting the Delivery and Sleepy Snails
scenes.summary: Acting sous-chef Max tries giving orders to the kitchen and inspects a delivery of Burgundy snails from Timur, suspecting that the snails have gone bad.

scenes.title: Signing the Invoice and Nastya's Parents
scenes.summary: Max proudly tells Chef Barinov that he signed off on Timur's fresh delivery, while Nastya's furious parents confront Kostya at the bar over their missing daughter.

scenes.title: The Staged Kidnapping and the Ransom Call
scenes.summary: Nastya's father receives a ransom call demanding a large sum of money that very day, revealing that Nastya staged her own kidnapping with her homeless friends.

scenes.title: Fedya's Contraband Snails
scenes.summary: Realizing the snails in the cooler are dead, Max asks Fedya for help, and Fedya offers to hook him up with a smuggler who sells snails five times cheaper.

scenes.title: The Ransom Bag and Walking the Snails
scenes.summary: Nastya's father packs the ransom money while his wife begs him not to bring a weapon and lets Kostya tag along, while Chef catches Max sneaking in contraband snails.

scenes.title: The Chef Leaves and the Tourists Arrive
scenes.summary: Max replaces the spoiled snails just before Chef Barinov leaves for the afternoon expecting a dead Monday, right as busloads of Chinese tourists arrive at Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Meeting Rodion Sergeyevich at the Drop
scenes.summary: Max realizes the replacement snails are also questionable, while at the ransom drop Kostya accidentally ruins the handoff by greeting Rodion Sergeyevich by name.

scenes.title: A Detective Novel Plan and a Full House
scenes.summary: Rodion explains to Nastya that Kostya's presence spoiled the pickup and suggests a contactless drop, while Vika welcomes the massive group of guests into the dining room.

scenes.title: The Chinese Tour Group and Max's Promise
scenes.summary: With the dining room packed with Chinese tourists and the kitchen short-staffed, Vika reaches for the phone to call Nagiyev, but Max begs her to let him solve the crisis.

scenes.title: Money in the Trash Bin and Calling the Chef
scenes.summary: Rodion instructs Nastya's father to drop the ransom in a corner trash bin and leave, while Max tries calling Chef Barinov for help with the packed restaurant.

scenes.title: The Burgundy Snail Cooking Show
scenes.summary: Short on time and cooks, Max wheels a prep table into the dining room to teach the Chinese tourists how to cook Burgundy snails themselves, while Kostya asks about the ransom.

scenes.title: The Garlic Trick and the Chef's Return
scenes.summary: Max dazzles the Chinese tourists by peeling garlic between two metal bowls, and when Chef Barinov bursts in yelling, the interpreter smoothly mistranslates his rant as praise.

scenes.title: Snail Day Triumph and a Talk with Vika
scenes.summary: After the Chinese tourists leave happy and full of snails, Max tries to apologize to Vika for ruining their relationship, but Vika tells him some things cannot be fixed.

scenes.title: Nastya's Father Tackles the Chef
scenes.summary: Spotting Chef Barinov carrying a plastic bag in the restaurant, Nastya's father mistakes him for the kidnapper and tackles him until Nastya runs out to stop the fight.

scenes.title: Nastya's Remorse and the Police Raid
scenes.summary: Nastya confesses to her father and Kostya that she staged the kidnapping to help her homeless friends, right before police officers summoned by her mother storm in.

scenes.title: Chinese Tips and Fedya's Notice
scenes.summary: Vika brings the generous tips left by the Chinese tourists, which Max insists on splitting with the whole kitchen, while Fedya announces he will quit in a month.

scenes.title: The Second Test of Loyalty
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov offers to make Max permanent sous-chef in place of Lyova, and when Max refuses to betray Lyova, the Chef announces that Max passed his test.

scenes.title: Revealing the Setup
scenes.summary: Max learns via flashbacks that Lyova's vacation, Fedya's rebellion, and Chef's departure were all carefully scripted by Viktor Petrovich to test him under fire.

scenes.title: Invitation to the Bathhouse
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov explains how he orchestrated the entire Monday trial and rewards Max for passing both the skill test and the loyalty test by inviting him to the bathhouse.
